text:
matt: Quick sync — prepping per-customer toggle for AcmeCorp VIP feature. Plan below, pls ack.

julia: Thanks. Do we have contract gating enforced? Acme is on a custom contract so feature should only be visible if contract.entitlements.vip == true.

alex: Yep — policy will check contract entitlement + tenant allowlist. Sketch: `if tenant in VIP_ZONE && contract.vip_enabled then enable_feature()`

olivia: Canary audience? thinking 5% of Acme users first, then 25, then 100. Want to keep a kill-switch window for the first 2 hours.

matt: Agreed. Proposed rollout: 5% (1h) -> 25% (2h) -> 100% (manual). Kill-switch: feature_flag.toggle(acme_vip, false) — will roll back instantly. Put SLO for latency & error-rate thresholds.

alex: Adding config snippet for flag store (for ops):
```json
{
  "flag": "acme_vip_feature",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "rules": [
    {"type": "contract_entitlement", "key": "vip_enabled"},
    {"type": "tenant_allowlist", "tenants": ["acme-corp"]}
  ],
  "rollout": [{"pct":5, "duration":"1h"}, {"pct":25, "duration":"2h"}]
}
```

olivia: Are we emitting a dedicated telemetry event? `vip_feature.exposure` with tags {tenant, rollout_pct, session_id} — need sampling at 1/10 to keep token costs down.

matt: yes, telemetry event + alert if error_rate > 1% or p95 latency regression > 200ms versus baseline. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/observability/dashboards/acme-vip (internal)

engops-bot: Deploy scheduled by @alex at 2027-10-12T15:40Z — canary window set to 1h. If `rollout_monitor` triggers, automated rollback will be attempted.

julia: Who is on-call to monitor? Need a primary and backup.

alex: I can be primary for first hour, @olivia backup. I'll watch errors + token consumption.

olivia: I'll watch cost and weird embedding spikes. Also will verify contract checks aren't too permissive.

matt: PR is up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/flags/pulls/812 — includes unit tests for entitlement gating and a simulation harness for 10k users. Please review before I merge.

julia: Quick code-review pinged. Two small comments on tests.

alex: Addressed comments, pushed fix. Also adding explicit test for tenant not in allowlist returning 403.

matt: Nice. After merge I'll trigger canary. Reminder: runbook for kill switch is in /runbooks/feature-flag-kill-switch.md — follow steps 1-4, page has the emergency contact list.

olivia: Acked. Will keep Slack thread pinned and use `#incidents` if escalation needed.

matt: Thanks all — aiming to start canary at 15:40Z. Will post roll-up at end of canary window. :thumbsup:
